top_concerns: Causal claim (implicit augmentation supports generalization) rests on descriptive consistency measurements with no intervention or quantitative link to the generalization gap
Temporal consistency is expected from slow drift and residual structure; no baselines (cross-seed, matched noise, non-residual nets) to rule out trivial explanations
Random-label collapse is confounded by different training dynamics; consistency is measured mostly on train data as self-agreement, not accuracy
Theorem 1 is informal and relies on an intractable, likely vacuous TV term; the NTK no-forgetting argument is not convincing
SGD anisotropy is well known and the sphericity test with tiny p-values is uninformative; limited scope (ResNet-20/CIFAR-10, no seeds or error bars)
